newsitem.title: USA: Texaco finds natgas in Gulf of Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Texaco finds natgas in Gulf of Thailand.

text.p: Texaco Inc said Thursday it discovered natural gas at Bussabong 2X well on Block B12/32 in Gulf of Thailand.

The well, drilled to a depth of 8,570 feet subsea, intersected a number of hydrocarbon-bearing zones. Tests were carried out at three separate depths, achieving a maximum flow rate of 21 million cubic feet of natural gas and 115 barrels of gas condensate per day.
The well was drilled by Texaco as part of a farm-in agreement with Songkla Resources Ltd, a subsidiary of Dragon Oil Plc.

Following approval of Texaco's agreement to earn an interest in Block B12/32 by the Thailand Ministry of Industry, the company will hold a 65 percent equity interest with Songkla retaining the remaining 35 percent.

Texaco said the test results at Block B12/32 are being evaluated to determine the future work program for the concession.President of Texaco International Exploration "This discovery, along with the recent award to Texaco of Block B11/38 to the north as part of the 15th bidding round, solidifies our position in the southern Gulf of Thailand. These blocks are highly prospective."
